- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended air purifiers include:
  - **Austin Air HealthMate Plus**: Made from a durable, steel body with a powder-coated finish; reusable filters; minimal packaging; take-back program for old units.
  - **Blueair Classic 405**: Recyclable metal body; minimal packaging; washable pre-filter; partners with organizations to plant trees for every unit sold.
  - **Levoit LV-H132**: Compact, energy-efficient design made from recyclable plastic; minimal packaging; filter replacement program.
  - **Dyson Pure Cool Link**: Recyclable design; energy-efficient technology; trade-in program for old units; goal to make all products 100% recyclable by 2025.
  - **RabbitAir MinusA2**: Stylish, wall-mountable design made from recyclable plastic and metal; eco-friendly packaging materials; filter replacement program.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested factors to consider when shopping for eco-friendly air purifiers:
  - Materials: Look for recyclable, sustainable materials.
  - Filter replacement: Opt for washable or reusable filters.
  - Energy efficiency: Choose models with low energy consumption.
  - Minimal packaging: Select products with biodegradable or recyclable packaging.
  - Manufacturer's sustainability initiatives: Research environmental policies.
  - End-of-life recycling: Consider take-back programs or recycling options.
